decisionRules.success: All immutable hashes, exact two-binding normalisation, complete corrected call templates, source normalisation, plan cardinalities, baseline schema and provenance pass; the seven unchanged direct controls revalidate from immutable v1 evidence; both 16-row null contrasts pass the sentinel; then both complete 256-row paired contrasts have zero mismatch in every canonical field, the ledger is unchanged, exactly 512 new identity rows and no enabled row are emitted, and all numeric ceilings hold.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Freeze this research-only exogenous acquisition factor as implementation-identity-safe and preregister the cheapest fixed-cohort activation/support panel. Do not call it policy sensitivity or causal benefit and do not change payoff, content, policy method, policies, seeds or cohort.
decisionRules.futility: After a green mechanical and schema preflight, a valid sentinel or complete null panel has a genuine path, RNG, policy, result, telemetry, reliability or canonical-row mismatch.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close the exact explicit-acquisition factor without retune, rerun, v3, enabled whole-run or subgroup rescue, then continue inside issue 421 with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism.
decisionRules.inconclusive: A required immutable artefact, source hash, two-binding normalisation, complete call template, probe invariant, cache object, schema, provenance, ledger identity, process or output is missing, or a frozen numeric cap is exceeded before a valid paired identity decision.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Record v2 inconclusive at the preregistered cap, run no enabled whole-run and do not repair or rerun this exact factor. Continue only as permitted by the current issue and owner authority.
